fld_description: Natural cruise key in YYYY-MM-NODC form (e.g. 1998-02-33JD); primary key of cruise.
notes: public cross-dataset join key; derive via derive_cruise_key_on_casts().

fld_description: Stable UUID for a cruise (SWFSC source tables).
notes: NOAA CruiseId; public join key to NOAA's CalCOFI database; released on cruise.

fld_description: NODC ship code key; primary key of ship.
NODC ship code.
Source ship code as provided by the data provider; resolve to ship_key.
Ship name as resolved against the NODC ship registry.
CalCOFI station key in 'line station' form (e.g. '090.0 062.0'); canonical spatial join key.
Stable UUID for a site occupation (SWFSC source).
CalCOFI grid-cell key; FK to grid. Assigned spatially via assign_grid_key().
Bottle/CTD cast identifier; primary key of casts.
Natural cast key.
Niskin bottle identifier; primary key of bottle.
Stable UUID for a plankton net sample (SWFSC source).
Stable UUID for a net tow (SWFSC source).
Sequential tow number within an occupation.
Net-tow identifier (source integer counter); primary key of a tow table.
notes: use where the source provides a stable integer rather than a UUID (cf. tow_uuid).

fld_description: Order of station occupation within a cruise.
Latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
notes: canonical over lat_dec; maps to DwC decimalLatitude on publish.

fld_description: Longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
notes: canonical over lon_dec; maps to DwC decimalLongitude on publish.

fld_description: Alongshore component of the CalCOFI coordinate system (https://proj.org/en/stable/operations/projections/calcofi.html).
notes: numeric; site_key encodes line+station as text. bottle keeps rpt_/st_/ac_ line variants distinct.

fld_description: Offshore component of the CalCOFI coordinate system (https://proj.org/en/stable/operations/projections/calcofi.html).
notes: numeric; bottle keeps rpt_/st_/ac_ sta variants distinct.

fld_description: Sampling depth below surface, in meters.
Seafloor (bottom) depth, in meters.
Feature geometry in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
notes: added via add_point_geom(); never strip.

fld_description: Observation (or sampling-event start) date-time in UTC. For instantaneous samples this is the sample time; for tows/casts it is the start.
notes: canonical event timestamp; derive from source date+time or Y/M/D + time components. used by match_by_site_datetime().

fld_description: Sampling-event end date-time in UTC (datetime_start_utc holds the start); e.g. net-tow end.
Year-month of the cruise (first day of month).
CalCOFI species identifier; primary key of species.
Scientific (Latin) name of the taxon.
Common (vernacular) name of the taxon.
ITIS Taxonomic Serial Number (TSN) for the taxon.
WoRMS AphiaID for the taxon.
Life stage of the organism (e.g. egg, yolk-sac larva).
notes: harmonize categorical values across datasets; ichthyo currently ships numeric stage.

fld_description: Type of measurement; FK to measurement_type. Vocabulary in metadata/measurement_type.csv.
Numeric value of the measurement; units carried by measurement_type, not here.
Quality flag or comment for the measurement.
Mean of replicate measurements at a unique position (site_key+datetime+depth+type).
Sample standard deviation of replicates; 0 when n_obs = 1.
Number of replicate observations aggregated.
Raw count of individuals.
Standard haul factor for abundance standardization.
Volume of water filtered/sampled.
Cruise label exactly as the source provided it; cruise_key is derived from it.
notes: keep when the source label does not round-trip from cruise_key.

fld_description: Provider study/cruise identifier string (e.g. CCE-LTER '2004-11-02-C-33RR').
notes: ship code is embedded in the trailing token; input to derive_cruise_key_on_casts().

fld_description: Provider short cruise code (e.g. YYYYMM '200411'); NOT a join key.
notes: use cruise_key for joins.

fld_description: Packed line/station value kept verbatim from the source, never decomposed.
notes: for sources whose packed station cannot be parsed unambiguously; site_key is resolved spatially instead.

fld_description: Sequential row identifier within a single source file.
notes: only unique within a file, not across the dataset.

fld_description: Which source schema a row was read under, for datasets spanning multiple file formats.
notes: part of the de-duplication key for multi-schema archives.

fld_description: Provider's reference number for a CTD deployment within a cruise.
notes: not globally unique; cast_id/cast_key are the keys.

fld_description: Provider's reference number of a sample bottle on the rosette.
notes: not globally unique; bottle_id is the key.

fld_description: Companion bottle number for matching to CTD bottle records for other data.
Dataset-local taxon key; crosswalks to the global taxon_key via dataset_taxon.
notes: local only — never publish as a cross-dataset join key; use taxon_key.

fld_description: TRUE where two source sheets disagree on a record's start hour.
notes: sio mesopelagic-fish cruise 1110; unresolved, defaults to the curated sheet.

fld_description: Seafloor depth at the sample position from GEBCO 2025 (bilinear; positive down; 0 on land; NULL outside the raster). Stamped on sample at release by calcofi4db::add_sample_seafloor(); compare with depth_max_m, allowing for the ~460 m GEBCO cell and minute-rounded historical positions.
notes: release-derived; not an ingest field

fld_description: First event date observed for a cruise (from its own tows); with date_max the span calcofi4db::resolve_cruise_key() matches events against.
notes: on cruise; written by add_cruise_date_span() in the ichthyo ingest

fld_description: Last event date observed for a cruise (from its own tows).
notes: on cruise; see date_min

fld_description: Two distinct uses of one name, at two grains. (1) On a per-event staging table (casts, sample, ...): how resolve_cruise_key() settled THAT ROW's cruise_key -- span (reference cruise date span), source (the source's own YYYYMM designation), month (event month); wrangling-only, not released. (2) On the released cruise reference table itself (calcofi4db >= 3.32.0, WS-B / complete_cruise_reference()): how THAT CRUISE ROW entered the reference -- swfsc (a real SWFSC ichthyo station-occupation cruise) or derived (added at release because some other dataset designates it and the SWFSC export has no station row for it); IS released, on cruise.
notes: on staging event tables: wrangling-only, not released, vocabulary span|source|month. on cruise: released, vocabulary swfsc|derived.

fld_description: The provider's own identifier for this event as shipped (SWFSC ichthyo site_uuid / tow_uuid / net_uuid, verbatim); NULL where the source mints none -- 15 of 16 datasets.
notes: on sample; calcofi4db >= 3.32.0 (WS-B, append_sample()'s 17th column). Not a public join key on its own -- the SAME provider UUID appears again as station_uuid wherever another dataset's event matches that ichthyo station occupation.

fld_description: The SWFSC station-occupation UUID (= ichthyo site.source_uuid) this event belongs to: the row's own site for ichthyo itself, matched for every other dataset. See station_uuid_method for how.
notes: on sample, every row (not just roots -- copied down from the matched/owning root via root_sample_key); calcofi4db >= 3.32.0 (WS-B, match_station_occupation()). NULL when unmatched.

fld_description: How station_uuid was determined: self (this row IS the ichthyo site), parent (a foreign row parented DIRECTLY to an ichthyo site, e.g. the crab's examined subsamples), order_occ (matched on cruise_key + site_key + order_occ), datetime (matched on cruise_key + site_key + a unique occupation within tolerance). NULL when station_uuid is NULL.
notes: on sample; calcofi4db >= 3.32.0 (WS-B, match_station_occupation()).

fld_description: Comma-separated, sorted list of dataset_key values whose sample rows carry this cruise_key -- which datasets designate or observe the cruise.
notes: on cruise; calcofi4db >= 3.32.0 (WS-B, complete_cruise_reference()); released.
